text:
maya_k: FYI Netlytic just finished the infra handoff call; spotted two blockers for private/VPC deploy: KMS key policy prevents cross-account audit ingestion and audit logs route is pointed at the wrong S3 prefix. Need quick sync.

samir_cs: Ugh. They flagged this as a potential renewal risk if audit retention/compliance can't be shown in 48h. Can we get a remediation plan today?

diana_netops: I can take the S3 prefix fix right now. Looks like the CloudTrail delivery is writing to netlytic-prod-audit/legacy/ instead of netlytic-prod-audit/redwood/. Will update bucket policy after we set the correct prefix.

carlos_se: I'll look at the KMS key policy. Initial check: the key's keyPolicy only allows their master account and not our service role to decrypt for log ingestion. We need to add a grant for redwood-audit-ingest@redwood-infra.

ivy_security: If we change KMS policy, we need to ensure CMK rotation and BYOK constraints still honored for their compliance. Also capture all changes in the audit trail (CloudTrail + Control Plane logs).

ops-bot: Deployment checklist updated: audit-routing=false -> true by diana_netops at 2026-03-21T15:04:00Z

maya_k: Proposal: diana updates S3 prefix + bucket policy, carlos crafts minimal key policy snippet and runs it by ivy, samir communicates timeline to Netlytic CSM and flags renewal playbook. Agreed?

diana_netops: Agreed. Doing S3 change now, estimating 12-18 min to propagate. I will also create a temporary lifecycle rule to keep objects in place until the ingest verification is done.

carlos_se: Drafting the KMS grant now. Suggested policy lines: 

```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodAuditIngest",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/redwood-audit-ingest"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

carlos_se: Will push to their staging key; ivy, please confirm before I apply to prod.

ivy_security: That snippet is fine but add Condition: {"StringEquals":{"kms:CallerAccount":"333344445555"}} so we don't open to other accounts. Also log the change via our change-control ticket (CS-4521).

samir_cs: I'm drafting a short message for Netlytic: timeline + ask for acceptance. Will include rollback plan and expected verification steps. Will also surface the potential renewal risk to AM (renewal flagged) with recommended Customer Success actions (weekly check-ins + compliance evidence pack).

maya_k: Good. Can someone own verification once changes are live? We need to confirm: 1) CloudTrail delivery to correct prefix, 2) Redwood ingest can decrypt via KMS, 3) Audit logs show entries for the key policy change.

diana_netops: I will run the verification for (1) and (2) once KMS grant applied. Will post logs and a short snippet showing the new object paths.

carlos_se: Applying to staging key now, will ping when done.

ops-bot: CS-4521: change-control ticket created by ivy_security. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4521

samir_cs: Sending Netlytic note: "We plan to apply a minimal KMS grant and correct S3 prefix in the next 30m. This should resolve audit ingestion; we'll request a 1-hour verification window. If successful, we'll mark the onboarding as green for audit/compliance. If not, we'll escalate."

maya_k: Perfect. After verification, I want a short enablement doc for Netlytic on how to rotate keys safely and verify ingestion. That'll help reduce renewal risk.

ivy_security: I'll own the enablement doc. Will include: KMS grant matrix, sample policy, audit verification commands, and retention checklist. ETA 24h.

diana_netops: S3 prefix fixed and bucket policy updated. Sample object path: s3://netlytic-prod-audit/redwood/2026/03/21/.. Posting head object response: {"Key":"redwood/2026/03/21/0001.json","Size":1542} :thumbsup:

carlos_se: Staging KMS updated. Test decrypt succeeded for redwood-audit-ingest role. Moving to prod in 15m after ivy sign-off.

ivy_security: Sign-off given. Proceed to prod and record change in CS-4521.

ops-bot: Action: prod KMS grant applied by carlos_se at 2026-03-21T15:22:10Z

samir_cs: Verification window started. Netlytic engaged.

diana_netops: Verified ingestion logs showing new objects arriving and access logs showing redwood-audit-ingest role access. Sending snippets and CloudTrail event IDs.

maya_k: Great work team. Marking onboarding audit bucket as healthy. Samir, please update renewal risk as "mitigated - need enablement follow-up".

samir_cs: Updated renewal status in CRM and scheduled a 2-week enablement check. Closing loop with Netlytic in the thread.
